title: Implement Scratch, tmpfs and Layer Purge on Container Exit
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Satisfy SRS-412-02-FR-008: The container engine shall purge all scratch volumes, tmpfs allocations, and intermediate layers immediately upon container exit. --rm already removes the container; also remove any named volumes the task created and run docker image prune --filter label=cochem.task=<id> for intermediate layers. Purge runs in a finally block even when the container crashed.
